text:
Self-host Arize Phoenix? Get 15.7.0+ (CVE-2026-53998, CVSS 10).

Its f-string prompt templates used Python's format(), which follows attribute access, so a template could reach the server's env vars. Auth's off by default.

Exposed? Rotate those and its stored LLM keys.
